title: Sandwich man pleads guilty to manslaughter in death of sister
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime A Barnstable Superior Court judge sentenced 67-year-old Kenneth Beltrame to more than 20 years in jail.
A 67-year-old Cape Cod man pleaded guilty on Friday to manslaughter in his sister’s death after her body was discovered in their shared Sandwich home in March, court records show.
Kenneth Beltrame told police he believed his sister — 61-year-old Jennifer Beltrame — suffered a medical emergency after a physical altercation between the two, but he did not call 911.

title: Man found dead after shooting at officers in Dorchester, police say
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime No officer fired their weapon during the altercation, according to preliminary information from the Boston Police Department.

A man who allegedly shot at Boston police officers in Dorchester on Monday morning was found dead following a SWAT response and negotiations with the suspect, according to the Boston Police Department.
No BPD officers fired their weapon during the incident, according to preliminary information provided by the department.

title: The average Massachusetts family spent more than $34,000 on health care last year, report finds
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Local News Insurance premiums accounted for nearly $30,000 of that total, as health care costs continue to outpace income growth.
A bed on the 5th floor patient’s rooms at Mass General Brigham’s Newton Wellesley Hospital.

(John Tlumacki/Boston Globe) By Annie Jonas November 16, 2026 | 3:53 PM 2 minutes to read A typical Massachusetts family spent more than $34,000 on health care in 2025, or about $2,846 a month, according to new figures from the state’s Health Policy Commission.
